notes.title: StarRupture - Developer Update: September '25
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to our newest Developer Update. This month, we’re reminding you about the new PC Early Access release date on Steam and inviting you to meet the in-game enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a72858e44127ce1f8001279cfbf30c65adb72d0c.jpg

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/c4ec85263a327837b234519018eeddf7302226a2.png

In case you missed it, StarRupture will debut in PC Early Access on January 6th, 2026.

We can't wait for you to set foot on the Arcadia-7 planet surface, but we need a little extra time for more polish, more improvements, and more reasons for you to enjoy StarRupture when it launches on Steam early next year.

[previewyoutube=25KyPKN-FD4;full][/previewyoutube]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/e4cc617c1bb09243f7f66a361afb9698cc29c966.png

The alien race you will encounter during your sentence on Arcadia-7 is known as “Vermin”. Long before you were sent to the planet, the expeditions ahead of you managed to analyze them and categorize them as follows:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/1a22678ce00d4f49a73c6c1a894144f626076c35.jpg

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f86dd2083fa8e2feb25d78518a4fff99d2435dec.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7ac16d0b783d380d91cb9634c44560bc3dee1260.jpg
The most basic vermin life-form. A great waste of bullet rounds. They usually attack in groups and seem to be the easiest to eliminate, but the fact that they’re quick and move in a “swarmy” manner makes them rather burdensome to deal with. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a5c2ff664fc38e2faa7eac1ccd5a3b7ee32d7687.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ffbc2534efff5c409db8fbc716c7a932806795de.png

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/1f9ab076c36f19a07711f2b1898cbaa3b096c3b9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2e56f4a120162ef183392d5f572a163bd9c82432.jpg
A bigger and more powerful version of the Swarmer. A melee enemy that attacks with its extra sharp spike-shaped arms. When dealing with a Slasher, be sure to spike it with your bullets first rather than get spiked with their arms…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ce097f8cc60b4a53d616d5d28a2e6b188519e5c4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6d904d4deb43b6547be1481b6e21636b0179d5be.gif

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f473aa145bcdae5a76ff12855091c84e9850d72f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a37475b78abfd46417050fb7127964bacdab9f6a.jpg
It’s the biggest melee of the Vermin family. It attacks by charging at you with full speed, deals great damage with its slashing attack, and it’s also capable of blasting a ground wave towards you. Its whole body is covered in armor, but it has one (very specific!) weak point! Co-operation will be greatly required to deal with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b05156a2edef49850b72c17dcaf133e145f15e02.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3f5f868d1f3651fcbce639e9ab207c6206ac8d89.gif


Watch the micro-trailer video for the melee category of enemies down below. 

[previewyoutube="drHTvpOcDWk;full"][/previewyoutube]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/774a7a71165caced861d9a9f431eee990ea42eaf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f24a660b3be43ae453bf2d2006b8d959c12d9f3b.jpg
It attacks by exploding. These kamikaze aliens go after the player to explode just in front of you. Their internals contain highly infectious gas that may be lethal for you, but for the vermin, it enrages them and makes them even more aggressive. Therefore, strategic extermination of exploders is highly advised.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2bde2b98f899c540e77ebbf453acb00dda8a620f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/c1b3eb55aa7b7d5e12b285b35823308092fce35e.png

Watch the micro-trailer video for the exploding category of enemies down below. 

[previewyoutube="Cmrn3g9vWjA;full"][/previewyoutube]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/1ff634ad2b46d8e58b94fb0280579b64cfaf1497.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6ac5086e5fb5c14a939126fcf90f4875d25fdbf6.jpg
A small ranged enemy. When endangered, it protects itself by spitting corrosive acid directly on its targets. Its attack range is rather short, so it’s wise to deal with them from a distance in order to have enough time to dodge their acid spitting. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8dbd4b031a257ae2e652cfb1027d6ad2e432a808.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/74a834c95c7c3aca7575ff2f5c47416bc0169401.gif

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/5300c4e842d62c68b315aa0dee4c06933e657ce4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3693e30a345f7621ed4f93f77e1fab62c6946397.jpg
A bigger version of the Spitter. It shoots acid projectiles from its tail like a cannon. When their projectile hits a target, it bursts into smaller droplets of acid, just like a fragmentation grenade. Beware not to step into its corrosive acid stains, as it can easily burn through your shield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b6b8b7c821333b5f733a3ccddcd2af505e95463f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ccdd49aef446a258a75795ba47baae99febec675.gif

Watch the micro-trailer video for the ranged category of enemies down below. 

[previewyoutube="BQPeJ5GA1VQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]


And that’s all for our September StarRupture Developer Update. There are still some secrets we intend to reveal before the game’s Early Access launch on January 6th, so stay tuned for more!

Until next time,
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Playtest Extended! Again! Play up to August 11th
notes.content:
The Claywood Corporation would like to thank you for your accomplishments during the current playtest. Taking into account your exceptional results and significant contribution to our operations, we’ve decided to award you with a 7-day extended service.
– GAL, your Galactic Assistance Liaison

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/9f4b9973ce95f4b973d7a0a30b56114242a8d569.png
Hi everyone!

Thank you again for your enormous response to our StarRupture playtest! We’re constantly watching the videos you’re making, the screenshots you’re posting on social media and our Discord, and reading the feedback you are providing us with…
So, as we don’t want the good things to end so abruptly, we’ve decided to stretch the playtest one more time! 

We’re EXTENDING the StarRupture Single-Player Playtest until Monday - August 11th 19:00 CEST / 10:00 AM PDT, to give you EVEN MORE time to explore, expand your base, reach that one (or four) level in the Corporation ladder you wanted to reach, find that one new mineral you wanted to find while defending yourself from everything Arcadia‑7 throws at you.

If you haven't got the chance to play yet - Request Access to the Single-Player Playtest right now on our Steam Page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/
💬 Feedback & Support

We’re still gathering all kinds of feedback—from bug reports to general vibes and gameplay thoughts. Got a bug? Tell us on Discord or email support@creepyjar.com.

If you’d like to provide us with your feedback about the playtest, please fill out this short form:
https://forms.gle/WXi4ACxAakzCfozA6

Remember that we have a very helpful F.A.Q. regarding the Playtest, which you can check out in our previous Steam news. https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1631270/view/539986220231426541

And yes, there is still no autosave (😬), so remember to save often!

Keep surviving out there!
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Single-Player Playtest available now
notes.content:
Featuring exciting single-player content, the StarRupture playtest will put you firmly into the treacherous world of Arcadia-7. Simply click the “Request Access” button now on our Steam Page and enjoy it until July 31st.

While StarRupture is a co-op game at heart, where up to four players work together, we also want to ensure that the game is fun and engaging for those who play solo. 
This playtest will introduce you to the core elements of StarRupture, ranging from base building and exploration to survival and combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/39d1c56d37cd304499b73f115d1eea55e6338d55.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6460036fe6da7948d75754d545b2dbcb612a41f8.png

Welcome to StarRupture, an intense first-person open-world survival game where you’ll build sprawling industrial bases, harvest valuable resources, and battle alien monsters. The planet is gorgeous, dangerous, and constantly evolving. Exploration, combat, and creativity are your keys to survival.

Meet Chris Bonnet - aka Prisoner 0212 - aka Scientist. He will be the character you play during the single-player playtest. You will have the opportunity to get to know him a little better during your time on Arcadia-7.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7fc61da4a7cff71290591c7ced5e36b0e2007ab6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

🧪 Closed Playtest is available for a limited time only!

The playtest kicks off July 29 at 10:00 AM CEST / 1:00 AM PDT and ends July 31 at 7:00 PM CEST / 10:00 AM PDT. To join, just head over to our Steam page and click “Request Access”. It’s that easy—and yes, it’s 100% free!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/0d6a4f8cad9d9bbf6a3b5d3469a49d0d0d1a71bf.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

🎮 What’s in the Playtest?

The StarRupture Single-Player Playtest features over three hours of gameplay split between an early slice of the game featuring the game's core mechanics, a guided tutorial, and a free play option with map restrictions (the Playtest covers around 15% of the Early Access build map), but it’s a first taste of the fun that awaits in StarRupture. 

Some gameplay mechanics will be locked out for now (and left for you to fully explore when the game launches in Early Access this Autumn), such as wildlife, base attack and defense, corporate assignments and rewards over a certain level (6-7 depending on the corporation), the Forgotten Engine, some weapon unlocks with mods, and enemies. So don’t worry about the spoilers, the game will have plenty of fresh and new elements once it launches!

The Playtest supports English VO and interface localisation, and the full list of supported languages for StarRupture’s launch in Early Access is available on the game’s Steam Page.

There is no time limit on your session—play as much (or as little) as you want! However, no co-op for now—we’re focusing on single-player balance and stability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8d30579e3715ea9492082d22d8de1eae107d7951.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

🧱 Platforms & Requirements

 Platform: PC via Steam
 Controller Support: Not available yet
 Ultrawide Support: Nope—for now
 Download Size: ~13 GB (~45 GB after installation)
 Hardware Requirements - recommended: 

 Windows 10 or later, 64-bit 
 Intel Core i5 11400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 
 24 GB RAM 
 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT 
 DirectX 12 
 SSD Disk
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

🗣️ Languages & Access
 Playtest is English-only for now (interface + audio). You might find a few cases of AI voiceover; they are currently included in the build as placeholders and will be replaced by proper actor recordings for the Early Access release.
 No NDA! Share your experience publicly—screenshots, streams, memes, go wild. Maybe show off your wakiest base? Or the most impressive kill?
 Players will be selected randomly by Steam and will receive email notifications when they’re eligible to play. No Steam key required—access is added to your account.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

💬 Feedback & Support

We want all kinds of feedback—from bug reports to general vibes and gameplay thoughts. Got a bug? Tell us on Discord or email support@creepyjar.com.

If you’d like to provide us with your feedback about the playtest, please fill out this short form:
https://forms.gle/WXi4ACxAakzCfozA6


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

❓Other Stuff You Should Know
 No criteria to sign up—just a PC and a Steam account
 If you’re not selected this round, you’re still in the pool for future tests
 There is no official age rating for the game yet, but we recommend 16+ (PEGI 16 / ESRB T guidelines)
 Want updates? Follow us on Steam and our socials
 Got questions? Join our Discord—our team and community are there to help
 More playtests? Stay tuned on our channels!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

🧠 The Big Goal

This test helps us with everything in the early game, including bug tracking, game balance, performance, feedback, and, most importantly, how the experience feels. You're helping shape StarRupture before its Early Access launch this Autumn. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f8e6ead97f20ac7b59d0bbd2b9b2c31a817502ca.png

PLAYTEST BUILD KNOWN ISSUES

Menu & Saves
[olist] Switching between tabs in the Options menu randomly causes some settings to become greyed out.
 The save file is not created in the slot selected by the player; it always saves to the first save slot on the left.[/olist]
Gameplay
[olist] A crash may occur when attempting to place multiple Supported Platforms at once.
 A crash may occur when upgrading or deconstructing Rails.
 The game may temporarily freeze when placing multiple Supported Platforms for the first time in a session.
 Drones may stop delivering items to constructions. This can be resolved by deconstructing and rebuilding the affected rails and machines.
 When loading a save made during the Tutorial, the Tutorial widget does not appear until an objective is progressed.
 Dropped items stack up to a maximum of 100; any items beyond that limit disappear when dropped.
 If the Player obtains items with a full inventory, the excess items fall to the ground and may clip into each other.
 Deconstructing the entire base using the Deconstruction option in the Base Core spawns a container tower that may be unreachable by the Player.
 After reloading a session, all Quartz may disappear if the game was saved near a Quartz deposit. Quartz will reappear during the next Heat Wave.
 Unequipping the Building Tool while walking results in interrupting Player's movement.
 Hydration and Calories warning icons do not light up after loading a save.
 Machines set to OFF are turned back ON after reloading the save.
 The autosave function currently works only at the start and at the end of the tutorial.[/olist]
Visuals
[olist] The Map currently uses placeholder visuals.
 Enemies may occasionally appear slightly blurry or may flicker.
 Upon loading a save made during a Heat Wave, the critical temperature state and some visual effects may be missing.[/olist]
Miscellaneous
[olist] Dialogues may overlap sporadically.[/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8ef81461a9d35efde0799f882b581b59ac62f94c.png"]

notes.title: Developer Update - June '25
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/75567d10c2e0e02a5deeeb4cb5eb512afd780085.jpg"]

Hello everyone!

Welcome to our fresh and exciting Developer Update. This month, we’re inviting you to check out our co-op mode in action, and we’re sharing more info about the effects of the scorching fire wave, and how you can unlock your inner interior designer.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/e1cb02b9a4215096823b3509391ef87d1e5a453c.png"]
[previewyoutube="sLRb7-OuHag;full"][/previewyoutube]

After publishing the newest extensive look at StarRupture co-op gameplay video, we have received a ton of feedback and comments! Thank you for being so active, this helps us understand what you’re most excited about in the game and lets us answer at least some of your questions in this Developer Update. 

  

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3ab97063cc086577d2c4a96940a5657c74380431.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/eed1507c00b231eadead136283747dbb38338fcc.gif"]


The event of the Ruptura’s Fire Wave brings a lot of danger for every living being on the Arcadia-7 planet. But you know what they say - “better safe than sorry”. And that’s where Base Core comes into play. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b0e3d341a2cdfd5547aad6a6fed4fee2baf78cbf.gif"]


The passage of the wave of fire does not mean that our base will be wiped out - thanks to the brilliant invention of the Selenian Corp -  Base Cores. Base Cores - crucial for setting up your base - protect and cool down the buildings within their perimeter.  

You will also be able to level up the Base Cores so they will be able to restore the factory operations even faster… but it will come at a price, and we’re not necessarily only speaking here about the resources needed to do it…

[previewyoutube="SX5A063JKb4;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="rQ3ctvERoBE;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="UifkRFNJkIY;full"][/previewyoutube]
 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/967517a710c4bb314e78d24c900bfa70c00b0903.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8c1912809bfdca49716ad19001e1ca84ba890b4d.png"]

In StarRupture, you and your friends will be able to not only scratch the itch of creating your own, custom factories but also cool and chilling-looking habitats. 

The Habitats you will build across the planet’s surface will be your safe spots. They’re not only perfect hideouts to stock & refill your supplies and plan your next actions, but also great places to hide from the scorching heat or waves of enemies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/95b46d77e711101449f211f00c801a02edecda01.png"]

With the building tool, you will be able to create your habitats on the flat lands of the planet, or even more wicked designs on the hill sides. 

You will be able to customize your habitats with additional segments and combine them with vertical or horizontal connectors, add additional airlocks for entrances, and viewports for an extra look at the vistas. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/57c5378a8ff0ad68eaa8d4b52381fe0a45beddda.png"]

You will also be able to freely decide where to place your storage, progression, and crafting machines. Hopefully, your vision will align with that of your teammates, but if it doesn’t, you can always build another habitat in a different location.

We can’t wait to see the creative designs of your habitats you will make in StarRupture. 

  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ad7f14bf4623df3b35594a618d6c0e27d620a2b7.png"]
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8799cb0ae1469f158851b2cd70df002cc5017b9a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ad5f34b0171b157f274db8eb8d547413d6c2524e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/d45feac2126553f6a67082f9e55196e9848d464e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/5fc09f12c320ab912935c32303190a62ff26b1f6.png"][/carousel]
In StarRupture, you will be able to take your 3 friends on a mission in which you will extract, automate, and ship the resources from the Arcadia-7 planet.  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/340575dc680100ca280480b8ded5ccbd01151058.png"]

You will mark a new chapter in the history of humanity - and the future of the Claywood Corporation - the company that sent you across the galaxy to explore and document this undiscovered world.   


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8adb55d042144c16fc5228a3f96f980545f77ed1.png"]

As you progress further, you will uncover different resources that need different machinery to collect them. They have one thing in common, though - Drone Rails. They will not only function as a transportation route to connect them with other machinery or storage buildings, but also as a means to transfer the energy needed to power them.    

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/63b55d5ed3eaa8e898051f9e40c292c35e2791a5.png"]
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/fb0521fafd8da4e52b5c6fc71fb00fc6f50a7323.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/dceb1bdf3f33288626ef4a72eab2b07fb3d0cd76.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/585d37ae0b50f0e0540839b685129889e4cad26e.png"][/carousel]
Last month, we showed you the monoliths - now… we’d like to show you how they’ve changed! 

They’re now much harder to find - that’s for sure! And they are very much connected to the base defense… but we will reveal more about it later on.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2b2bc035f681f9d471f07b3a59e202bf792fdeb8.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



And that’s all for our StarRupture Developer Update in June - we hope you’ve enjoyed the never-before-seen content and that you’re hungry for more! 

Stay tuned for our fresh & exciting updates on socials and right here on Steam as well, as we’re on our road to the Autumn 2025 Early Access launch.  



Until next time,  
Creepy Jar Team  



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8ef81461a9d35efde0799f882b581b59ac62f94c.png"]

notes.title: Developer Update - May '25
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/d526e307098af18629dd01c983064fc5a1f7ba8b.jpg

Hello everyone!

Welcome to our next Developer Update. This month, we’re inviting you to check out Exploders, Monoliths & Tastes of Arcadia-7 in our blog post.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/79335049e5f966a3cb8ddb652923694121c16eee.png

In case you missed it, at the very beginning of this month, we shared an extensive video reel showcasing the beauty and wonder, as well as the mysteries and dangers, of the planet Arcadia-7 in action.

[previewyoutube=srtUwMGwCuE;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re super stoked about the feedback you’re sharing with us. It was a real pleasure reading your comments about the game. And be assured, we’re not stopping there! We’re working hard to deliver the game to you this very Autumn, so come and see what we’re preparing for you.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2ea3b021173376d4208382f4252c7d61718a3f6a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/c5d03fa271d872739eab4f6e13850f2bd76c1541.png
Okay, okay - it was just our April Fool’s prank that we did to make that special day a little bit more joyful. Green Hell crossover is not confirmed - sorry! But if you’d like to see what our take on April Fool’s in the world of Green Hell - check out this post. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/95cad938a45e15ea0222bee000d875e8c402adce.png

You may have noticed on our social media some mysterious monoliths placed in various locations across our planet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/803187db11010d1387ebe2da9a429b06a7bb0027.png
What is their purpose?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/4987fca9f5333112ffe392ea5b06dc3a39cd61ee.png
Why are they placed in so many different areas and biomes?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f1ec1aa331c09443c20cf350f4f5c5a58aeff598.png
Maybe you’ve wondered what’s the secret behind them? Share with us your guesses, there are no wrong answers! (or… we’ll be the judges of that ;)) 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7324e28fd702945f95cd578a1428c679125aa451.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/76c2ef5ff1579316d077da1831a06057ca7c2c6a.png
Those “Exploders”, as we like to call them internally, are one of the types of enemies you will encounter when exploring the world of StarRupture. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f2c1ca3b6dd8bcbf04c52edf3ff72cb46d3d26e0.png
When you catch a glance of them, stay vigilant! They are very fast and determined, and will use all their leg power to scurry down to you just to reach enough distance to pump up their ulceration, burst it, and spray you with an unknown blue substance. And yes, this will hurt. And yes, it will get to your eyes. And yes, the rest of the monsters will be extra enraged at you. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7581076d7033273fec435325490a4e81e40d6fb5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/db3272eeda84f1bc48947159c0a7d398823f8396.gif
We’ve had so much fun while designing these little nasty creatures - and we won’t say that you will have fun while dealing with their attacks, but getting rid of them definitely will be a satisfying experience. Pop, pop, pop…

Check them out in action in our little video:
[previewyoutube=2KHEPrC0fgI;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/fcff31ce3ce52b57bd43c074cad7818393d6b4ae.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3e33027f144c97f2a4d02962b8bf904700d100db.gif

Going on an adventure and protecting your factory is not an easy task, especially when everything needs to be done at the same time. You can try leaving the base by itself with a sturdy collection of defense turrets, but how about some personal gear? In StarRupture, you will be able to select a variety of guns and upgrade them with a selection of mods to match your gamestyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/4175df16e553f796e332ba2477c7cb707e0941ee.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/70ba030bfd901f34569418b72020af7867e6b025.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/4a308a044087896ce3ff2d494b63645d16129480.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/d6b58918f5ff25ef08d9e12ac748c1ed70045a4f.png
Do you have your “always-favorite” weapon in games? Let us know in the comments!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8436d376ff6e74e7718236525a8dd77390a15a1b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/982a55290e7f0ef5ccf70639c9d5e95c006048b9.png
Arcadia-7, the rich in resources planet, is also filled with various edible fruits of nature - their effects will be a crucial element within the survival aspect of the game.

All be tasty, nutritious, and energy refilling? Or maybe some of them may make your tummy… or brain hurt? Before you will be able to find and try the consumables in StarRupture, feast your eyes on the images below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/74a073768daed538772e961474b21f3c9a51bba1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ea6a3424e46e54498f01c83a892627b417c64139.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/39ee85d621838bf2857b76df07c1cef822066d3b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/69e06c953da37f7c2952d6e567b7942862617f08.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/810496bca7971bdcdf9aa62cc2951eff3ffbe4b5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a1a784df3a59339e167bb29cd9fdcf623d4732ad.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png


And that’s all for our StarRupture Developer Update in May - we hope you’ve enjoyed the never-before-seen content and that you’re hungry for more!

Stay tuned for our fresh & exciting updates on socials and right here on Steam as well, as we’re on our road to the Autumn 2025 Early Access launch.

Until next time,
Creepy Jar Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/ {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8ef81461a9d35efde0799f882b581b59ac62f94c.png

notes.title: Developer Update - April ‘25
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We invite you to read our April news recap and give you a sneak peek at what we’ve been working on with our game so far.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

[previewyoutube=nCfCB8ZIwK8;full][/previewyoutube]
At the beginning of this year, we shared our extensive and long-awaited full gameplay trailer, which showcases the core pillars of our game: building a functional factory and base for your operations, exploring the new and mysterious open-world planet, and combating otherworldly, ever-energy-hungry enemies. The trailer also included the release window for our Early Access launch, which is coming in Autumn this year! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/4b4971e9669fd6404274a9557e464d24e128295f.png
By the end of February, we reached a big milestone for our game - we’ve surpassed over 25,000 followers here on Steam. Thank you for your engagement, and we’re very happy to see you becoming as excited about the game as we are! 

To increase your appetite, we’ve added some brand-new screenshots from the game. If you’d like to see them in HQ, head over to our Discord server, where you can find them all as a special 🎁. You can use them as desktop wallpapers, notebook inlays, or wall prints. you name it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/e26c48359aa2ec7f4832246736499b532370a143.png
To see more details, we’re inviting you to follow us on our social media. We regularly post new content, such as behind-the-scenes materials on how StarRupture is coming to life. If you’d like to be the first to see them, follow us on your favorite social media channel.

But if you’re not into social media, don’t worry! We’ve prepared a neat recap of what is happening in our development for you so that you can take it all in a big - but condensed - form down below. Enjoy!




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ef4d107f3c17fdbec631ac9178ef884242d1c06b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2eaec03770298cbe95b04cedb67119d1a1c33fff.png

After showing our shooting mechanics in our gameplay teaser, we’ve read and taken your feedback seriously, so you’ll be able to enjoy improved mechanics that now feel much more natural and satisfying. 

We’ve tweaked the animations, added case extractors, re-done the audio feedback, and sprinkled it with some more polish - please see it for yourself on the video below:
[previewyoutube=uqi4n2vD6Wo;full][/previewyoutube] If you’re eager to see more - check out our full gameplay trailer in action on YouTube.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3214a8e88c6370527aeacde9c17360990d21ce13.png

During Valentine’s Day, we gave you a glimpse of how versatile our base building is - it does not only need to be functional, but can be fancy as well! 

Unleash your creativity to build with style, and sometimes you can also use your architectural skills to show somebody your feelings towards them! ;)
[previewyoutube=rlJIHzTo4U4;full][/previewyoutube]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2003cefe061f2f6e7176a674df7b3378f2e03523.png

Did you ever wonder how the various environments of StarRupture are made? Have a look at the video of one of our level designers, meshing a gully and using it to transition from one biome to another. 

Using rocks, vegetation, and dried-up stream beds, he properly transitioned an empty gorge into an authentic gravel desert. Every meter of StarRupture is designed intentionally for you to be fully immersed in our world.
[previewyoutube=k7UCYRMWVMU;full][/previewyoutube]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/977ac74cba48967a144bba165e886f5dce0de496.png

And what would a functional factory be without a smart logistics system? That is why we've created drones! 

They might not look like much, but they are the blood vessels of your base that will be essential to automate, expand, and deliver rare resources from one location to another. Honestly, they're kind of cute, too.
[previewyoutube=uewUxd3RKTM;full][/previewyoutube]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/06e82de41fe6d6863a2ce2292c622b4746f0b68c.png

Have you ever wondered in what world you will be experiencing all your adventures? Have a look at a couple of showcase videos of our unique environments of the planet Arcadia-7. 

The very first shows that our biomes are full of exciting discoveries. Rich sources of calcium nesting near water, titanium deposits on basalt structured hillsides, and strange alien flora with fruit waiting to be harvested… with something grand lurking on the horizon...
[previewyoutube=_VbihKJ9hvM;full][/previewyoutube]
The second one shows that Ruptura Star elemental waves play a huge part on the world in StarRupture. 
You will see how the regrowth phase affects the flora, making tree leaves grow anew, fruits become ripe for looting, grass and moss grow back, covering the rugged and rocky surface, and water reservoirs fill up again. 

In StarRupture, you will need to collect multiple resources from different wave phases not only to progress but also to survive...
[previewyoutube=clLJORAYHo8;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png

Thank you for reading our recap! We hope you’ve enjoyed it. We can’t wait to show you even more of the content that we’re currently working on! 

In the meantime, stay tuned for our fresh & exciting updates on socials and right here on Steam as well, as we’re on our road for the Autumn 2025 Early Access launch. 

Until next time,
Creepy Jar Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8ef81461a9d35efde0799f882b581b59ac62f94c.png

notes.title: See StarRupture Devlog #2 - we’re uncovering details about base-building
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44186271/9b33689f834d67e6a78711d973294f2f21d4d3aa.png

Hi, we're Creepy Jar, the Polish studio best known for our hardcore realistic survival simulator, Green Hell. Aside from supporting the title with new free updates, we're hard at work on our next title, StarRupture.

Being built in Unreal Engine 5, StarRupture is an ambitious cross between base building, exploration, combat, and resource management on an alien planet torn by a catastrophic cycle of destruction caused by its life-giving star.

In this episode of our devlog, we’re shedding more light on one of the core pillars of StarRupture: base-building!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/9074900f41104580d3660f7923a91046c1e49fe0.png

In this episode, Adam - our Product Marketing Manager, will be your host to smoothly guide you through this episode's talking points, and our wonderful and talented devs will chat about the game’s mechanics and what you can expect to find in StarRupture when it debuts in Early Access on Steam.

During this short journey to the dangerous world of our sci-fi planet, Kacper (Concept Designer) will discuss the creation of a world with futuristic technology, and our take on a power system based on electric conductivity. Bozhena (Senior Hard-Surface Artist) will reveal the creative process behind designing and making structures for your base. Julek (Lead Programmer) will talk in detail about the drone automation system that will help you automate your base and how you can set it up. 

See the whole video, including some behind-the-scenes footage of our production process, down below:

[previewyoutube=DHMW7qV1Jyc;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re already working on the next episode of our devlog to bring you some amazing footage of our mysterious and beautiful environment. Can you tell us what you’re expecting to see? We’d love to hear your thoughts in the comments section below. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/

Wishlist and follow our game here on Steam and your favorite social media, to be the first to know about our future news for StarRupture.

Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Say “Hello” to StarRupture & watch our first devlog!
notes.content:
We’re shedding the mythological shackles of the game’s previous title and proudly announcing a new name perfectly suited for our ambitious sci-fi setting!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44186271/fcf974a9207d1b73aeb4624e74ecc7d28f88eaa5.jpg

Hello Players!

Earlier this year, as part of the summer edition of the PC Gaming Show, we revealed our next game - a unique mix of base building, exploration, resource management, and combat on an alien planet torn by a catastrophic cycle of destruction caused by its life-giving star. 

Now - we’re excited to reveal the game’s new title—one that we feel is much more representative of the unique world we’re creating—say hi to “StarRupture”.

[previewyoutube=8AeQeigwU8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to this news, we’re launching our devlog series about the game. In the first part, we want to show you a deeper look into the name change and everything that the team’s been working on since the game’s reveal. Check it out below:

[previewyoutube=RpzbZqdPth8;full][/previewyoutube]
As we work towards StarRupture’s Early Access PC launch, we will release further devlogs in the coming months for exclusive behind-the-scenes looks at the development process.

Everything from production milestones to sneak peeks at some of the game’s many mechanics, enemies, and mysteries are all on the table. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/9315edf005a0768aad17f6a0ce80a55d37e4c028.png
We’re excited to continue sharing with you more updates on StarRupture, as much as we were focused on doing so with Green Hell. 

Wishlist and follow our game here on Steam, and our brand-new social media channels, to be the first to know about our future news for the game.
